title: Consecutive Support Matching Induced Parameter Tuning Accelerates Momentum Iterative Hard Thresholding
summary: Momentum-based acceleration of iterative hard thresholding (IHT) can dramatically speed up sparse signal recovery from linear measurements, but its effectiveness hinges on careful parameter tuning -- a task complicated by the frequent support changes inherent to hard thresholding.
